verdict.rationale: a-Shell is described as entirely open source under the FreeBSD license, and the GitHub repo is public. The core product is a local Unix-like terminal that runs on the user's own iPad or iPhone, executing commands, languages and WebAssembly binaries on-device, so the user runs the whole product themselves. missing for 10: documented build-from-source/sideload instructions, explicit confirmation that no vendor-hosted service is required, independent corroboration of self-building the app.
